text:
alexa: Quick note from yesterday's onboarding: a customer hit duplicated side-effects when their client refreshed tokens and then got 429s. They were testing the sample-app.
diego: Do we know which SDK and what sequence?
alexa: Node 1.x and our Java prototype. Sequence: POST -> 401 -> client refresh -> retry -> 429 -> SDK retries -> duplicate. No Idempotency-Key present.
hiro: Classic collision: auth-refresh completes, then retry policy kicks in without checking idempotency. We should make parity rules explicit in SDKs.
alexa: Proposed immediate fixes: 1) sample-app should recommend always sending Idempotency-Key for mutating routes; 2) SDK default: do not auto-retry mutating requests across token refresh unless idempotency-key present; 3) expose `allow_safe_replay` flag (false by default) for advanced users.
diego: For 429 backoff defaults, I'd suggest base=30ms, multiplier=2, cap=2500ms, full jitter. If Retry-After header exists, honor up to 5s cap.
hiro: Also: streaming bodies must not be auto-replayed unless rewindable or the app has explicitly opted-in. SDK should return a clear error if a replay would be required.
alexa: Small sample-app patch idea: middleware to auto-add Idempotency-Key for local dev, and a token-refresh helper that queues mutating calls until refresh completes. We'll include a code comment explaining why.
qa-bot: Added a quick CI check: dx-idem-check — fails if POST to /orders or /webhook lacks an idempotency-key OR explicit //dx:allow-unsafe-replay comment.
pipeline-bot: New alert rule: duplicate-side-effects > 0.2% over 5m -> ticket #1420 created.
diego: Let's also add telemetry: sdk.replay_across_refresh.count with tag (idempotency_present=true/false). Makes it easy to detect regressions.
hiro: I'll draft a short parity RFC (Node/Java/Python/Go) covering: auth-refresh ordering, 429 defaults, Retry-After handling, streaming body policy, telemetry, and sample-app updates. Keep it <=1 page.
alexa: I'll open the sample-app PR with middleware + CI lint. Assign reviewers @hiro @diego.
diego: Thanks — once merged, update quickstart with a short blurb about idempotency and refresh interactions so customers see it during onboarding.
alexa: Will do. :thumbsup:
